audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[0..6].side are all 'Skill' while content win[0]-win[5] say 'Xerath' and win[6] says 'Taric' — the two layers disagree on every stage.
audit.why: win[N] already carries the correct verdict (Xerath's dashless-punishing range wins levels 1-5, Taric's Bravado/W-stun/R answer flips it at 2+ items). The full layer's neutral 'Skill' sides and generic whys contradict that.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..5].side to 'Xerath' and phases[6].side to 'Taric', matching win[], and rewrote each phases[N].why to state the real reason (Arcanopulse range, Eye of Destruction poke, Shocking Orb stun, global R snipe, Bravado/W-stun payoff) instead of the generic skill-matchup filler.

audit.why: Spikes already correctly tie to Xerath's level-2 Q/W online, his level-6 global R, and Taric's first-item sustain plus 2-item W-stun/R answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: No field states that Taric's Dazzle (E) cancels Xerath's R (Rite of the Arcane) outright, and spikes[1].text names the R 'Rite of the Ancients' instead of the real name 'Rite of the Arcane'.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags rule channel-interruptible: Rite of the Arcane immobilizes Xerath and is interruptible by any CC — Taric's E stun cancels the whole channel, not just one shot.
audit.corrected: Rewrote report[5].t (Key Ability Interactions) to add the E-cancels-R fact, and fixed the fabricated ability name in spikes[1].text.

edits.before: Bravado-weave the trades — the empowered autos refund cooldowns; the loop is the lane.
edits.after: His screen-length Q Arcanopulse out-ranges your dashless kit — hug minions and Q-heal it off.

edits.before: Q-charges bank heals: the gemstone economy opens.
edits.after: Q-plus-W poke chips freely; you only have heals.

edits.before: Full kit: W-link the carry and the E stuns from two bodies — the double angle is the trap.
edits.after: His E Shocking Orb finally lands a real stun, letting him land the full poke-into-combo.

edits.before: Stun the margins off the link's geometry — their spacing answers two Tarics.
edits.after: His range wins every walk-up; you cannot close the gap to punish it.

edits.before: Cosmic Radiance online — dives on your duo meet a scheduled invulnerability.
edits.after: His global R snipes your carry from fog before your R Cosmic Radiance can reach.

edits.before: First item: the stuns chain and the heals compound.
edits.after: His poke lead grows; survive to your first item.

edits.before: Late Taric un-kills teamfights: R the dive, link the carry, and stun the formation twice per rotation.
edits.after: Bravado sustain and W-stun engage finally punish his poke, and R shrugs off his artillery ult.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E, Stun, 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s CD): his only real CC — dodge it and the artillery combo never converts. - Keep R Cosmic Radiance banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Stun only after his rotation is spent — Arcanopulse, Eye of Destruction and Shocking Orb all need to be down.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: E from a flank angle only — a front-angle stun still leaves you in his Eye of Destruction zone.

edits.before: Track Xerath’s Shocking Orb (Stun): His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Xerath’s Shocking Orb (Stun), his only CC — dodge it and the artillery never converts. If he channels R, your Dazzle (E) cancels it.

edits.before: His R Rite of the Ancients fires up to three global artillery shots that can snipe your ADC from fog; your R Cosmic Radiance can save the target if timed to the incoming shell, but you must have already E-linked to be in range.
edits.after: His R Rite of the Arcane fires up to three global artillery shots that can snipe your ADC from fog; your R Cosmic Radiance can save the target if timed to the incoming shell, but you must have already E-linked to be in range.

notes: Level chart layers disagreed for every stage (full said 'Skill' everywhere, content said Xerath 0-5 / Taric 6) — fixed per the chart rule by moving full.phases[N].side to match win[N] and rewriting each why to match, grounded in real ability names/cooldowns (Arcanopulse, Eye of Destruction, Shocking Orb E 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s, Rite of the Arcane). Fixed a fabricated ability name in content spikes[1].text ('Rite of the Ancients' -> real name 'Rite of the Arcane'). Added the missing channel-interrupt interaction (Taric's Dazzle cancels Xerath's R channel) into report[5].t, staying within the 2-report-entry sweep limit. Also fixed the two lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED entries and the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT finding. Xerath and Taric are both male, no pronoun issue.
